title: The review system as an axis space — 222 knobs, two defects, and a classifier that failed
summary: A full enumeration of the code-review pipeline's tunable values: 222 individually-settable constants and parameters, rolled into 65 axes with range, current home and change-clearance for each. Commissioned to produce a test separating platform invariants from per-consumer settings; the enumeration succeeded and THE TEST FAILED, and both outcomes are published. WHAT THE SURVEY FOUND. (1) The three homes a review lever can live in carry three different change-clearances and the assignment does not track how load-bearing the lever is: the policy contract is human-gated, the escalation rubric is agent-clearable, and the jury core sits in no policy tier at all. The genuinely escaped set is exactly THREE constants — PREVENTION_IMPACT_BAR, EVIDENCE_FLOOR, and MANDATORY_LENSES membership. An earlier draft said 'and every round cap' and was wrong: the care-to-jury conformance suite is itself spec-leashed and pins each band's lenses, jurors-per-lens and round cap, so the round caps have an indirect but real human backstop. MANDATORY_LENSES membership escapes because the suite pins band lenses as a subset of PANEL_LENSES, and PANEL_LENSES is the UNION of the mandatory and advisory lists — so moving the security lens from one list to the other leaves the union byte-identical and the suite green while removing that lens's power to block a land. (2) THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FINDING, and nobody had named it: the contract's human gate protects the DEFAULT, not the value used. scoreEscalation merges a caller-supplied thresholds object over the human-gated contract value, and the review CLI accepts mandatoryLenses straight from caller JSON with only a non-emptiness check — so a reduce payload naming a single advisory lens yields a structurally valid panel verdict in which the security lens no longer blocks. This is a hole in the ratified contract-split pattern itself, inherited by every gate built on it wherever the implementation also exposes the value as a defaulted parameter. (3) Long-tail inventory: three seated-lens rosters with two values and a charter table covering only four of five lenses; two independent and unrelated impact bars; duplicate round-cap constants in one file with independent derivations and nothing pinning them equal; divergent juror defaults for effort, budget and a timeout documented at half its real value; a per-seat tool grant the panel path never forwards; and a ship bar for candidate gates that exists only as unenforced prose. WHY THE TEST FAILED, recorded rather than deleted. A four-question scope test was drafted — every lever is a setting at SOME scope, and a platform invariant is one pinned above every scope a consumer controls — whose first question admitted any lever a consumer could coherently set differently and allowed ONLY incoherence as an exclusion (cost and local fit being setting values, never membership tests). Run on the diff-size refuse threshold ruled one day earlier in the same cluster, it returns 'a repo-scope consumer setting'; that ruling was the opposite, and not on cost: there is no value of the knob that is correct, so it is not built. The ground used was neither cost nor incoherence but DOMAIN-MISAPPLICATION OF THE UNDERLYING PROXY — the 400-line figure is a human attention ceiling and attention is the one property an agent panel does not share with a human reviewer. That third exclusion ground is the survey's one durable contribution to classification, and the repo was already using it without having written it down. The test is withdrawn rather than patched: a classifier that mis-classifies the ratified case one card away has not earned reuse. HONEST VERDICT ON THE FRAMING: not load-bearing. Three claimed leverage points all failed on inspection — the build change it claimed to cause was already written by a sibling card that gates the build; the clearance asymmetry required reading the files rather than classifying them, and the repo's ratified contract-split rule already supplies both diagnosis and fix; and a claimed reconciliation between the size ruling and the scoped-fan-out story was retracted outright, because that story already states the reconciliation in its opening line and explicitly forbids the remedy the argument implied. Zero of the four open cards it was meant to help would be ruled differently. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the external review-effectiveness figures reached this survey secondhand from the commissioning brief, no primary paper was read, and two of them are about ensembling and do not support the authoring convention they were attached to. Full grounding, with every retraction shown rather than silently corrected, in we:reports/2026-08-27-review-system-lever-catalogue.md.
